# Provenance

Based on https://github.com/ariankordi/OunceCake at `ecd197a0decd770ea19dfc9d8d692598e42a852b`. Upstream history and attribution are retained.

Adds installed ELicense contexts, base-only views and raw NCA export. The original project is https://github.com/misshexa66/OunceCake. The upstream license and native server are unchanged.

Base titles prefer matching ELicense rights before classic tickets. Storage failures retain their original cause.

Direct DLC IDs select Data content and expose RomFS without ExeFS. Updates and DLC reuse the held ELicense context.
